'''Meori Cove''' was a small cove on the southeastern edge of [[Garrow's Neck]], one of the peninsulas on the continent of [[Alanciar]]'s [[Six Claws]] region. Alanciar was a continent on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] southern hemisphere. During the [[Invasion of Alanciar]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Edell Vrai]] and his local [[Alanciari]] guide [[Quarra Thayn]] managed to infiltrate Alanciar by using Meori Cove, which was shadowed by the [[Eskellon Mountains]] and was not under surveillance from the [[Alanciari military]].
